name: workforce-ai
description: Check Point Workforce AI — AI & Browse security policy management, asset visibility, and GenAI app catalog

options.help: The Client ID of an Infinity Portal API key with the Workforce AI Security (and Browse Security) service.
The Secret Key of the Infinity Portal API key.
The Authentication URL / gateway shown when creating the API key. EU: https://cloudinfra-gw.portal.checkpoint.com, US: https://cloudinfra-gw-us.portal.checkpoint.com
Optional region override (EU, US, ...). Normally inferred from the gateway URL.
Set WRITE_MODE=true to expose the 24 write tools. WARNING: enabling write mode lets the LLM create, modify, and delete security policy rules.
